LightningComponentBundle.description: Related list with server-enforced scope, search, typed filters, full-list sorting and optional bulk delete.

property.name: listDefinition
property.label: List Definition Key
property.description: DeveloperName of an Advanced Related List definition (Setup > Custom Metadata Types). When set, it controls the records, columns and actions, and the legacy fields below are ignored.

property.name: listTitle
property.label: List Title
property.description: Title shown on the card. Blank uses the object's plural label.

property.name: recordsPerPage
property.label: Records Per Page
property.description: Rows per page (1-100).

property.name: customIconName
property.label: Custom Icon Name
property.description: SLDS icon name, for example standard:contact.

property.name: iconBackgroundColor
property.label: Icon Background Color
property.description: Hex colour such as #1589EE. Other values are ignored.

property.name: flowTitle
property.label: Flow Modal Title
property.description: Label of the flow button and dialog.

property.name: childObjectApiName
property.label: Legacy: Child Object API Name
property.description: Used only when List Definition Key is blank. Example: Contact.

property.name: parentLookupField
property.label: Legacy: Parent Lookup Field API Name
property.description: Used only when List Definition Key is blank. Example: AccountId.

property.name: fieldsToDisplay
property.label: Legacy: Fields to Display
property.description: Used only when List Definition Key is blank. Comma-separated field paths, for example Name,Email,Account.Name.

property.name: searchableFields
property.label: Legacy: Searchable Fields
property.description: Used only when List Definition Key is blank. Comma-separated text fields.

property.name: columnLabels
property.label: Legacy: Column Labels
property.description: Used only when List Definition Key is blank. Comma-separated labels in the same order as the fields.

property.name: sortableFields
property.label: Legacy: Sortable Fields
property.description: Used only when List Definition Key is blank. Comma-separated fields users can sort by.

property.name: flowName
property.label: Legacy: Flow API Name
property.description: Used only when List Definition Key is blank. Screen flow that receives recordId.
